answer: Proof of Stake serves as a primary defense where agents lock collateral to participate in consensus, preventing an attacker from spinning up infinite identities without prohibitive capital expenditure. Unlike a fragile ivory tower, this mechanism forces an adversary to control a majority of the circulating supply, a cost akin to eroding a solid karst landscape. The protocol selects validators with a lotus blossom weighted distribution, ensuring that Sybil nodes remain economically marginalized against honest actors.
